        ), open_tickets AS (

            open_session.started_at AS open_session_started_at,

            open_session.device_identifier AS open_session_device_identifier,

create or replace view public.v_restroom_check_timers as  WITH restroom_locations AS (
         SELECT group_row.id AS location_group_id,
            group_row.group_code,
            group_row.group_name,
            location.id AS location_id,
            location.location_code,
            location.location_name
           FROM public.location_groups group_row
             JOIN public.location_group_memberships membership ON membership.location_group_id = group_row.id AND membership.active = true
             JOIN public.locations location ON location.id = membership.location_id AND location.active = true
          WHERE group_row.active = true AND lower(COALESCE(location.form_type, location.location_type, ''::text)) = 'restroom'::text AND public.sch_is_public_restroom_group(group_row.id) AND NOT (location.location_name ~~* '%East Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%West Admin%'::text OR location.location_name ~~* '%Elephant Trunk%'::text)
        ), activity AS (
         SELECT session.location_id,
            COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) AS activity_at,
            COALESCE(submitter.display_name, employee.display_name) AS actor_name,
            COALESCE(completion_device.device_id, device.device_id) AS device_identifier
           FROM public.sessions session
             LEFT JOIN public.completion_responses completion ON completion.session_id = session.id
             LEFT JOIN public.employees submitter ON submitter.id = completion.submitted_by_employee_id
             LEFT JOIN public.employees employee ON employee.id = session.employee_id
             LEFT JOIN public.devices completion_device ON completion_device.id = completion.device_id
             LEFT JOIN public.devices device ON device.id = session.device_id
          WHERE COALESCE(session.ended_at, completion.submitted_at, session.started_at) >= public.operational_day_start(now()) AND session.status = 'closed'::text AND ((completion.response_json ->> 'work_result'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'checked_no_cleaning_needed'::text OR session.ended_at = public.mz_latest_verified_check(session.location_id, public.operational_day_start(now()), now()))
        ), latest_completion AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (restroom_1.location_id) restroom_1.location_id,
            activity.activity_at AS last_completed_at,
            activity.actor_name AS last_completed_by,
            activity.device_identifier AS last_completed_device
           FROM restroom_locations restroom_1
             LEFT JOIN activity ON activity.location_id = restroom_1.location_id
          ORDER BY restroom_1.location_id, activity.activity_at DESC NULLS LAST
        ), current_owner AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (assignment.location_group_id) assignment.location_group_id,
            assignment.assigned_employee_id,
            employee.display_name AS assigned_owner,
            assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AS coverage_start,
            assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone AS coverage_end,
            assignment.coverage_purpose,
            assignment.status
           FROM public.static_weekly_v6_read_schedule_segments(public.sch_service_date(now())) assignment(service_date, location_group_id, group_code, group_name, included_locations, included_location_ids, segment_id, segment_number, owner_type, assigned_employee_id, assigned_employee_name, coverage_start, coverage_end, status, load_points, coverage_purpose, notes, source_type, service_mode, governed, projection_status, version_id, publication_id, projection_id)
             LEFT JOIN public.employees employee ON employee.id = assignment.assigned_employee_id
          WHERE assignment.service_date = public.sch_service_date(now()) AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone >= assignment.coverage_start::time without time zone AND timezone('America/Chicago'::text, now())::time without time zone < assignment.coverage_end::time without time zone
          ORDER BY assignment.location_group_id, (
                CASE
                    WHEN assignment.coverage_purpose = ANY (ARRAY['restroom_check'::text, 'restroom_upkeep'::text, 'area_owner'::text]) THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END), assignment.coverage_start DESC
        )
 SELECT public.sch_service_date(now()) AS service_date,
    restroom.location_group_id,
    restroom.group_code,
    restroom.group_name AS schedule_package_name,
    restroom.location_id,
    restroom.location_code,
    restroom.location_name AS scanned_restroom_name,
    latest.last_completed_at,
    timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at) AS last_completed_at_central,
    latest.last_completed_by,
    latest.last_completed_device,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval
            ELSE NULL::timestamp with time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN timezone('America/Chicago'::text, latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval)
            ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
        END AS next_check_due_at_central,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NULL OR latest.last_completed_at IS NULL THEN 'not_cleaned_yet'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= now() THEN 'overdue'::text
            WHEN (latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval) <= (now() + '00:15:00'::interval) THEN 'due_soon'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS timer_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM latest.last_completed_at + '01:30:00'::interval - now()) / 60.0)::integer
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS minutes_until_due,
    owner.assigned_employee_id,
    owner.assigned_owner,
    to_char(owner.coverage_start::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_start,
    to_char(owner.coverage_end::interval, 'HH24:MI'::text) AS owner_coverage_end,
    owner.coverage_purpose,
    owner.status AS owner_status,
        CASE
            WHEN dashboard.latest_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND latest.last_completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'scan_completion'::text
            ELSE 'no_scan_today'::text
        END AS timer_source
   FROM restroom_locations restroom
     LEFT JOIN public.v_location_dashboard_status dashboard ON dashboard.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN latest_completion latest ON latest.location_id = restroom.location_id
     LEFT JOIN current_owner owner ON owner.location_group_id = restroom.location_group_id;;
